sentences.hanzi: 重阳节快到了，小明和丽丽跟着爸爸妈妈去爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Chóngyángjié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì gēnzhe bàba māma qù páshān.
sentences.english: The Double Ninth Festival was approaching, and Xiaoming and Lili went mountain climbing with their parents.

sentences.hanzi: 那天早上，天气很好，天很蓝，风也很轻。
sentences.pinyin: Nà tiān zǎoshang, tiānqì hěn hǎo, tiān hěn lán, fēng yě hěn qīng.
sentences.english: That morning, the weather was very nice, the sky was very blue, and the wind was also very gentle.

sentences.hanzi: 山上的人很多，大家都来爬山看菊花。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng de rén hěn duō, dàjiā dōu lái páshān kàn júhuā.
sentences.english: There were many people on the mountain; everyone came to climb the mountain and see the chrysanthemums.

sentences.hanzi: 山上的菊花开了，有黄色的、白色的，还有紫色的，非常好看。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng de júhuā kāi le, yǒu huángsè de, báisè de, hái yǒu zǐsè de, fēicháng hǎokàn.
sentences.english: The chrysanthemums on the mountain had bloomed; there were yellow ones, white ones, and also purple ones, very beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 小明对丽丽说：“你看，这些菊花多漂亮啊！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: “Nǐ kàn, zhèxiē júhuā duō piàoliang a!”
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to Lili, "Look, how beautiful these chrysanthemums are!"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽笑着说：“是啊，我最喜欢那朵紫色的花。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe shuō: “Shì a, wǒ zuì xǐhuan nà duǒ zǐsè de huā.”
sentences.english: Lili said with a smile, "Yes, I like that purple flower the most."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷年纪大了，走路有点儿慢。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye niánjì dà le, zǒulù yǒudiǎnr màn.
sentences.english: Grandpa was getting old, and he walked a bit slowly.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“爷爷，我扶您走，您慢一点儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: “Yéye, wǒ fú nín zǒu, nín màn yīdiǎnr.”
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Grandpa, let me help you walk; please take it slow."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽也说：“爷爷，我也扶着您，我们一起慢慢走。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě shuō: “Yéye, wǒ yě fúzhe nín, wǒmen yīqǐ mànmàn zǒu.”
sentences.english: Lili also said, "Grandpa, I'll also support you; let's walk slowly together."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷高兴地说：“好孩子，谢谢你们。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye gāoxìng de shuō: “Hǎo háizi, xièxie nǐmen.”
sentences.english: Grandpa said happily, "Good children, thank you."

sentences.hanzi: 他们一边走，一边看花，还拍了很多照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yībiān zǒu, yībiān kàn huā, hái pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: They walked while looking at the flowers, and also took many photos.

sentences.hanzi: 到了山顶，全家人找了一个地方坐下来休息。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le shāndǐng, quánjiārén zhǎo le yī gè dìfang zuò xiàlái xiūxi.
sentences.english: When they reached the mountaintop, the whole family found a place to sit down and rest.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈拿出带来的菊花茶和重阳糕。
sentences.pinyin: Māma ná chū dài lái de júhuā chá hé Chóngyáng gāo.
sentences.english: Mom took out the chrysanthemum tea and Double Ninth cake she had brought.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸给大家倒茶，茶很香。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba gěi dàjiā dào chá, chá hěn xiāng.
sentences.english: Dad poured tea for everyone, and the tea was very fragrant.

sentences.hanzi: 小明喝了一口茶，说：“真好喝！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hē le yī kǒu chá, shuō: “Zhēn hǎo hē!”
sentences.english: Xiaoming took a sip of tea and said, "It's really delicious!"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我也要喝，我还要吃一块重阳糕。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: “Wǒ yě yào hē, wǒ hái yào chī yī kuài Chóngyáng gāo.”
sentences.english: Lili said, "I want to drink some too, and I also want to eat a piece of Double Ninth cake."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷吃着重阳糕，脸上笑得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye chīzhe Chóngyáng gāo, liǎn shàng xiào de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: Grandpa was eating the Double Ninth cake, smiling very happily on his face.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽拿了一朵小菊花，轻轻地给爷爷戴上。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì ná le yī duǒ xiǎo júhuā, qīngqīng de gěi yéye dài shàng.
sentences.english: Lili picked a small chrysanthemum and gently put it on Grandpa.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“爷爷，祝您健康长寿，天天开心！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Yéye, zhù nín jiànkāng chángshòu, tiāntiān kāixīn!”
sentences.english: She said, "Grandpa, I wish you health and longevity, and happiness every day!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑着说：“谢谢丽丽，爷爷真高兴。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiàozhe shuō: “Xièxie Lìlì, yéye zhēn gāoxìng.”
sentences.english: Grandpa said with a smile, "Thank you, Lili. Grandpa is really happy."

sentences.hanzi: 全家人一起笑，山顶上很暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Quánjiārén yīqǐ xiào, shāndǐng shàng hěn nuǎnhuo.
sentences.english: The whole family laughed together, and it was very warm on the mountaintop.

sentences.hanzi: 这个重阳节，他们过得很幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège Chóngyángjié, tāmen guò de hěn xìngfú.
sentences.english: This Double Ninth Festival, they had a very happy time.
